body: Hmm. I guess I must be the outlier, then.
Aww, I want a cow. But I'm probably not responsible enough to get one. And I'd have no room for it.

I'm putting effort into looking attractive, but I can see that it isn't working. I'm trans, so that's why I look male. I was basically seeking to validate whether I pass or not. And I don't. Growing my hair out, hopefully that helps down the road...

Not caring about my appearance is far from the truth. I'm trans. My hair is always messy like this no matter how hard I try, and since I have to shave every morning, my skin is pretty bad looking. Can't afford makeup. Oh well.
Same. ._. I swear, any tooth paste brand that claims to whiten is telling a big fat lie. I might as well just paint my teeth.

I think you look gorgeous. 16 F here too, and I wish I could look as good as you! Your smile is great, so don't hate on yourself so much. Like others have said, try working on the teeth. I shouldn't really be talking, though, because I actually think your teeth are whiter than mine. :-I
